## CI & Workflow Hardening
- #1530: Fixed host-guard target set to cover the selector whole-tree sentinel.
- #3233: Added enforcing delegation-health check workflow.
- #1929: Dropped nested preflight for skip-token caller; CI Summary expects repo evidence.
- #1922: Parallelized detect-secrets-hook with xargs -P.
- #1813: Bumped actions group with 7 updates.
- #3578: Pinned reusable that derives writer app's pin-only exemption in-job.
- #3529: Hosted hardcoded-model-config reusable workflow in omnimarket.
- #1703: Pushed release tags with App token so release.yml fires.
- #231: Added dev-only main-target-guard.

## Delegation & Runtime Logic
- #3800: Added Claude review gateway with voter endpoint per lab host.
- #1817: Added terminal cause for delegations cut off by runtime shutdown.
- #3719: Routed merge-sweep plan compute from runtime tick.
- #3530: Distinguished backend UUIDs for shared model ids.
- #3494: Added tests for receipt identity after rerouting.

## Evidence Gates & Exemptions
- #1820: Exempted writer app from OCC evidence gates only when pin-only is proven.
- #3349: Restricted hand-authored OCC defer to PRs named by open companion.
- #1219: Added receipt-honesty validator to fail gamed DoD receipts.
- #3701: Bound queued-PR clause of AC3 to live readback of dev's merge queue.

## Quality & Validation
- #3437: Refused leading reasoning at the quality floor.
- #1093: Added configurable aislop validators with per-repo YAML overrides.
- #1413: Scoped mypy ignore_missing_imports per-module.
- #3153: Allowed release-cut's main sync to accept 40-character commit SHA.
- #2987: Excluded drafts and autobind policy declines from missing-stamp outcome.

## Infrastructure & Data
- #369: Produced deployment-config hygiene context and ran its hook.
- #1306: Added canonical recorded-from-real golden-chain replay harness.
- #1187: Merged infra-only EnumDispatchStatus members into canonical core copy.
- #1778: Revived sealed OMN-17732 bundle for backend and permission security.
- #3561: Pinned omnidash v1.1.5 bundle for onex dashboard.
- #2937: Declared session_content ownership for migration vendoring.

## Documentation
- #985: Defined ONEX on first use in omnibase_core.
